launch_gradio_widget_ter: launch a gradio widget for the Hugging Face ter metric loaded via evaluate.load
load_ter_metric: load the Hugging Face ter metric module using evaluate.load with the metric name ter
run_ter_metric_evaluation: run the ter metric evaluation on translation hypotheses and references via the gradio widget
review_evaluate_load: review the evaluate.load function that loads the ter metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
summarize_gradio_widget: summarize the gradio widget interface for interactive ter metric evaluation
